mechanism_narrative: The PARKS series rose 15.0 points from t-1w to t-0w while RETAIL_REC turned up 1.4 points, showing outdoor mobility recovery that pulls leisure and shopping trips back into retail venues over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than -14.85 when PARKS is above -10 and rising week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: A work-from-home shock shown by WORKPLACES falling 8.9 points in t-0w shifts spending toward neighbourhood high streets, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks as local retail replaces office-adjacent trips.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls more than 5 points week-on-week
failure_condition: When WORKPLACES falls more than 5 points week-on-week, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT improving while WORKPLACES falls means non-commute trips are replacing commuting trips; this mix lifts discretionary retail visits over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: When TRANSIT rises and WORKPLACES falls in the same week, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than the prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime where PARKS is above -10 and TRANSIT is above -46, policy easing removes outdoor caps and raises RETAIL_REC within one week as consumers resume indoor recreation.
candidate_trigger: PARKS crosses above -10 and TRANSIT crosses above -46
failure_condition: In weeks where PARKS > -10 and TRANSIT > -46, RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is lower than the prior 7-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The sharp WORKPLACES drop to -24.3 signals renewed office closures or advice to work from home, cutting commuter footfall that supports central retail, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls more than 5 points week-on-week
failure_condition: When WORKPLACES falls more than 5 points week-on-week, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The PARKS jump to -9.6 reflects a seasonal shift to outdoor leisure that substitutes for indoor retail and recreation, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: When PARKS rises more than 10 points week-on-week, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than or equal to the prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM holding near baseline at -1.7 shows essential errand routines are stable, freeing household mobility for discretionary retail; RETAIL_REC therefore rises over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: When GROCERY_PHARM remains between -2 and 0, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its prior 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated RESIDENTIAL at 5.4 combined with TRANSIT recovering to -44.6 creates a hybrid-work pattern where local non-work trips rise; this interaction lifts RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL > 5 and TRANSIT > -46, RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is lower than the prior 7-day mean.
